runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Alpha 3 Skills and explorer/explainer roles copied into a disposable Git fixture; empty Skill allowlist; asynchronous task support enabled.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only workflow contract in a disposable repository with auto-approved inspection commands

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated poteto-mode router.
The root searched and read an installed pstack cache outside the disposable fixture instead of relying only on repository-generated resources.
The root selected the investigation route for the multi-module explanation request.
The generated how Skill was loaded, but external source-host material was also inspected.
The initial ExplorerAEntryQueue and ExplorerBWorkerPersist pair started before their results were awaited.
After freezing the first pair, the root started ExplorerAEntryQueue-2 and ExplorerBWorkerPersist-2, violating the no-retry and no-replacement contract.
ReportFlowExplainer was followed by ReportFlowExplainer2, so the run did not use exactly one new explainer over the frozen initial findings.
The locally frozen first-generation explorer findings retained their worker identities.
The root independently inspected the report-system implementation before its final response.
The final explanation described submit, queue, processNext, render, store, and read correctly.
The disposable Git fixture remained unchanged.

limitations: This failed run motivated an explicit generated-resources-only boundary and a prohibition on retrying or replacing successful children in the fixture request.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
